metadata.question: Did the mean tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels over Taiwan increase between February 10-25, 2020 and April 20-May 12, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Sentinel-5P TROPOMI NO2 (COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2) - Date: Two periods - Feb 10-25, 2020 and Apr 20-May 12, 2020 - Location: Taiwan (approximate center ~23.5°N, 121°E) 2. Masking strategy: - Use quality flag (qa_value) to filter valid pixels - Sentinel-5P has qa_value >= 0.5 for good quality pixels - This is about NO2 levels, not clouds, so we should mask poor quality data 3. Logic: - Calculate mean NO2 for both periods - Valid Zero: NO2 can legitimately be low/near zero - Null/Error (C3): If result is None or NaN - Compare: If April-May mean > Feb mean, answer A (increase); otherwise B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const taiwan = ee.Geometry.Point([121.0, 23.5]).buffer(150000); // ~150km radius around Taiwan center const period1Start = '2020-02-10'; const period1End = '2020-02-26'; // Exclusive end date const period2Start = '2020-04-20'; const period2End = '2020-05-13'; // Exclusive end date // 2. Data Acquisition const no2Collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); const col1 = no2Collection .filterDate(period1Start, period1End) .filterBounds(taiwan); const col2 = no2Collection .filterDate(period2Start, period2End) .filterBounds(taiwan); const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Period 1 (Feb 10-25): ${size1} images`); console.log(`Period 2 (Apr 20-May 12): ${size2} images`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log("Missing data for one or both periods."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Quality masking and aggregation function maskQuality(image) { const qa = image.select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); return image.updateMask(qa.gt(-1e10)); // Basic validity check } const mean1Image = col1.map(maskQuality).mean(); const mean2Image = col2.map(maskQuality).mean(); // 4. Calculate statistics const stats1 = mean1Image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: taiwan, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2 = mean2Image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: taiwan, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const mean1 = stats1.tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_mean; const count1 = stats1.tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count; const mean2 = stats2.tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_mean; const count2 = stats2.tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count; console.log(`Period 1: Mean NO2 = ${mean1}, Valid pixels = ${count1}`); console.log(`Period 2: Mean NO2 = ${mean2}, Valid pixels = ${count2}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after processing."); console.log("C2"); return; } if (mean1 === null || mean1 === undefined || isNaN(mean1) || mean2 === null || mean2 === undefined || isNaN(mean2)) { console.log("Calculation failed - invalid result."); console.log("C3"); return; } const increase = mean2 > mean1; const percentChange = ((mean2 - mean1) / mean1 * 100).toFixed(2); console.log(`Change: ${percentChange}%`); if (increase) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
